create.title: Create a vault
create.subtitle: Deploy a non-custodial mandate vault enforced by immutable silicon on X Layer.
create.section1.title: 1. Limits template
create.section1.desc: Choose a preset risk profile or configure custom rules.
create.templates.careful.name: Careful
create.templates.balanced.name: Balanced
create.templates.agentSafe.name: Agent safe
create.templates.agentSafe.desc: High frequency, small trades, 1m cooldown, 48h withdraw delay.
create.templates.custom.name: Custom
create.field.maxTradeTooltip: The maximum amount in USDC of a single buy order.
create.field.maxDailyTooltip: Total USDC that may be spent across all buys within a UTC calendar day.
create.field.maxTradesPerDayTooltip: Maximum number of buy orders allowed in one UTC calendar day.
create.field.cooldownTooltip: Minimum time in seconds that must elapse before another buy order can execute.
create.field.expiryTooltip: Number of days after deployment when trading permissions automatically expire.
create.field.withdrawDelayTooltip: Mandatory timelock delay when requesting a withdrawal. Cannot be less than the factory minimum.
create.section2.title: 2. Who trades
create.section2.desc: Specify which address is authorized to submit trades within the mandate.
create.trader.tooltip: The trader key can only execute trades that pass the hardware logic. It cannot withdraw funds or loosen parameters.
create.trader.warningSame: Trader is the same as the owner wallet. While permitted, separating them allows autonomous agent operation.
create.section3.title: 3. Allowed tokens
create.section3.desc: Select ERC20 tokens the vault is permitted to buy. Base token (USDC) is excluded.
create.token.none: No tokens allowlisted yet. Add at least one token.
create.token.tooltip: Only tokens explicitly added here can be purchased by the vault trader.
create.token.error.notContract: Address is not a contract on X Layer.
create.token.error.isBaseToken: USDC is the base currency and cannot be in the buy allowlist.
create.token.error.readFailed: Failed to read token symbol or decimals from contract.
create.summary.title: Mandate summary
create.summary.text: This vault lets {trader} buy {tokens} with at most {maxTrade} USDC per trade, up to {maxDaily} USDC across {trades} trades per day, with a {cooldown} cooldown. The mandate expires in {expiry} days. Withdrawals require a {withdrawDelay} delay.
create.dialog.title: Confirm vault deployment
create.dialog.summary: You are deploying a new minimal clone MandateVault on X Layer through the factory.
create.success.title: Vault deployed successfully
create.success.desc: Your new mandate vault is now active on X Layer.
create.error.invalidAmount: Enter a valid USDC number (up to 6 decimal places).
create.error.minOneTrade: Must allow at least 1 trade per day.
create.error.minOneDay: Expiry must be at least 1 day in the future.
create.error.withdrawDelayTooShort: Withdrawal delay cannot be less than factory minimum.
create.error.amountMustBePositive: Amount must be strictly greater than 0.
create.error.tradeExceedsDaily: Single trade limit cannot exceed max daily volume.
create.error.noWallet: Please connect your wallet to deploy a vault.
create.error.notDeployed: Factory is not configured on this network.
